Name: Epaphroditus
Role: Messenger of the Philippians to Paul
Summary: Epaphroditus was the messenger of the Philippian church who brought Paul their gift and ministered to his wants; he fell sick nigh unto death, and God had mercy on him, before Paul sent him back with honour.
KeyStory: Epaphroditus was the messenger of the Philippian church who brought Paul their gift and ministered to his wants; he fell sick nigh unto death, and God had mercy on him, before Paul sent him back with honour.
LifeLesson: Risking health to serve another's need is the fellowship of the gospel in action.
